source: Fort Bend County, Texas — Voter Precincts 2025 (county GIS, Elections), split where a precinct has more than one ballot by the county GIS layers City Limits + City Limited Annexation (City of Houston), School Districts (Fort Bend ISD) and Municipal Utility Districts (Burney Road MUD)
note: Each polygon is a precinct, or the part of a precinct that gets one of its printed ballot styles. Parts the county layers place where no printed style fits (19 county address points in all) show the races on every ballot in the precinct and the official sample ballot link. Smallest first.
